mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at clear skies and a temperature of 26 degrees out at Badger Prairie County Park, all under the glow of a waxing crescent moon.

The Verona Plan Commission is meeting on December 7 to review new development projects, including proposed civil engineering and site plans for the Sub-Zero facility at Liberty Business Park. Additionally, municipal court notices are available for those needing to handle traffic citations or ordinance violations.

There is plenty to do in our community. Today, you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market or enjoy live music at Baileys Run and Paddy Macs. Tomorrow, head to the Verona Area High School Fine Arts Center for Take Me Home: The Music of John Denver.
In our weekly police report, on October 25, officers arrested a 40-year-old Verona man for an O W I offence after he was found stopped at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Today's flavor of the day is Caramel Cashew. The Culver's of Verona location opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and enjoy a treat.
